69d8264cf2.why: Both shift-and-blend results, the register copies, and the scalar updates are live, and SSE4.1 offers no distinct-destination packed shift to remove either initial copy.

bd39b9cc13.rewrite:
movzx eax,WORD PTR [rsi]
movzx ecx,BYTE PTR [rdi+0x19]
mov r8,QWORD PTR [rdi+0x10]
mov edx,DWORD PTR [rdi+0x18]
mov r9d,eax
and eax,0xffffffc0
imul ecx,eax
mov r10,r8
shr ecx,0x7
add ecx,0x4
shrd rax,rcx,0x10
sub edx,ecx
sub r8,rax
setb al
bd39b9cc13.why: The masked, zero-extended word in rax is below 2^16, so shrd rax,rcx,0x10 yields exactly rcx shifted left by 48. Computing the scaled value in ecx removes one copy while preserving the final subtraction and CF.

13a95f5a86.why: The loaded values, modified and shifted copies, and both subtraction results are all required, with no shorter SSE2 sequence apparent.

eb5e7be35b.why: Capturing incoming CF and computing the reverse subtraction followed by the flag-producing shift each require the existing instructions.

73f3a4e753.why: Every loaded or initialized register is live, and the final test is needed to produce the required flags.

a3a6aee3c7.why: The load, multiply-add, saturating pack, store, and three live scalar updates have no removable intermediate under SSSE3.

4e64c1d49d.why: Both multiply-add results feed the required packed store, and all three scalar updates are live.

43431fd6b8.why: Both multiply-adds, the saturating pack and store, and the pointer and counter updates are necessary under SSSE3.

efd59a7548.why: SSSE3 requires two 128-bit stores for this output, followed by the live pointer and flag-producing counter updates.

e5e4db080a.why: The two independent multiply-adds feed the packed output, and the store, pointer updates, and decrement all contribute required results.

854af612e6.why: Four 128-bit stores are needed for the arbitrary repeated vector under SSSE3, and both scalar updates are live.

e92a1cbff1.why: The arbitrary shuffle masks require two paths from the original vector, and both multiply-add and packed results remain live.

7ca5eedb9f.why: The copied intermediate feeds xmm0 while the second shuffle feeds xmm1, so all three multiply-adds and both packs remain necessary.

0150d71e1b.why: Both multiply-adds feed the packed result, both subsequent loads are live, and the comparison supplies the required SF and OF.

c917a16154.why: The two distinct 128-bit stores and all three scalar updates are required, with no combined store-and-update form for these vector values.

f3c030ef89.why: SSSE3 needs four stores for the two arbitrary repeated vectors, and the pointer and counter updates must also be preserved.

9990abdda5.why: Only the masked value in rax and the zeroed xmm0 are live outputs; the load, movd, shuffle, and minimum compute dead xmm4 and xmm5 values.

b19cc50588.why: Both independent multiply-adds feed the packed store, and widening them would require extra input assembly and coefficient replication while all scalar updates remain live.

b9433a3392.why: AVX2 requires the GPR-to-vector transfer, byte broadcast, duplicated memory load, and minimum to form the full ymm3 result.

e71fe97f42.why: The multiply-adds and pack produce live ymm0, while the separate permutation is needed for the stored ordering and all scalar updates remain live.
